```{r}
# --- Libraries ---
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)

library(spData)
```

```{r}
# spatial data
data("us_states", package = "spData")

# transform to WGS84 for leaflet and add state abbreviations
us_states <- us_states |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  mutate(
    ABBREV = state.abb[match(NAME, state.name)]
  )

state_points <- us_states |>
  st_point_on_surface() |>
  mutate(
    lon = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
    lat = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]
  ) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(ABBREV, lon, lat)

pollster_df <- read_csv(
  "C:/Users/lyons/OneDrive/Desktop/IML-FALL2025---Voter-Bias/webscraped_data/pollsters_2014_2024.csv"
) |>
  rename(voter = pollster_name) |>
  mutate(
    voter = tolower(voter),
    voter = str_replace_all(voter, " ", "-"),
    state = toupper(state),                          # FIX: standardize abbreviations
    state = ifelse(state %in% state.name,
                   state.abb[match(state, state.name)],
                   state)
  )


read_team <- function(path, label) {
  read_csv(path) |> mutate(team_focus = label)
}

team_dfs <- bind_rows(
  read_team("C:/Users/lyons/OneDrive/Desktop/IML-FALL2025---Voter-Bias/voter_team/voter_team_cutoff50_weighted_ohiostate.csv", "Ohio State"),
  read_team("C:/Users/lyons/OneDrive/Desktop/IML-FALL2025---Voter-Bias/voter_team/voter_team_cutoff50_weighted_lsu.csv", "LSU"),
  read_team("C:/Users/lyons/OneDrive/Desktop/IML-FALL2025---Voter-Bias/voter_team/voter_team_cutoff50_weighted_michigan.csv", "Michigan"),
  read_team("C:/Users/lyons/OneDrive/Desktop/IML-FALL2025---Voter-Bias/voter_team/voter_team_cutoff50_weighted_alabama.csv", "Alabama"),
  read_team("C:/Users/lyons/OneDrive/Desktop/IML-FALL2025---Voter-Bias/voter_team/voter_team_cutoff50_weighted_oklahoma.csv", "Oklahoma"),
  read_team("C:/Users/lyons/OneDrive/Desktop/IML-FALL2025---Voter-Bias/voter_team/voter_team_cutoff50_weighted_illinois.csv", "Illinois")
)

full_df <- team_dfs |>
  left_join(pollster_df |> select(voter, city, state, year), by = "voter", relationship = "many-to-many")

```

```{r}
# --- Shiny UI ---
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("College Football Voter Bias Across the U.S."),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("team", "Select Team:", choices = c("Ohio State", "LSU", "Alabama", "Michigan", "Oklahoma", "Illinois")),
      selectInput("bias_metric", "Select Bias Metric:", choices = c("bias1", "bias2", "bias3", "bias0_ap", "bias0_mean"), selected = "bias1")),
    mainPanel(leafletOutput("bias_map", height = 650)
    )
  )
)

team_coords <- tibble(
    team_focus = c("Alabama", "Ohio State", "Michigan", "LSU", "Oklahoma", "Illinois"),
    lon = c(-87.5391, -83.0189, -84.4750, -91.1871, -97.4457, -88.2272),
    lat = c(33.2140, 40.0040, 42.2780, 30.4133, 35.2059, 40.1020)
  )

# --- Shiny server ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {
    
  team_data <- reactive({
    full_df |>
      filter(team_focus == input$team) |>
      mutate(bias_value = .data[[input$bias_metric]])
  })

  output$bias_map <- renderLeaflet({

    df <- team_data() |>
      filter(!is.na(state) & state %in% state_points$ABBREV) |>
      distinct(voter, state, .keep_all = TRUE)

    state_bias <- df |>
      group_by(state) |>
      summarise(avg_bias = mean(.data[[input$bias_metric]], na.rm = TRUE), voters = n(), .groups = "drop"
      )

    plot_data <- left_join(us_states, state_bias, by = c("ABBREV" = "state")) |>
      mutate(has_voters = !is.na(avg_bias) & voters > 0)

    
    voter_points <- df |>
      group_by(voter, city, state) |>
      summarise(bias_value = mean(.data[[input$bias_metric]], na.rm = TRUE), n = sum(n), .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      left_join(state_points, by = c("state" = "ABBREV")) |>
      filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat)) |>
      mutate(
        popup = paste0(
          "<strong>", voter, "</strong>",
          "City: ", city, ", ", state, "",
          "Bias (", input$bias_metric, "): ", round(bias_value, 3), "",
          "Votes (n): ", n
        )
      ) |>
      group_by(state) |>
      mutate(lon = lon + rnorm(n(), sd = 0.3), lat = lat + rnorm(n(), sd = 0.3)
      ) |>
      ungroup()

    bias_range <- max(abs(voter_points$bias_value), na.rm = TRUE)

    pal_points <- colorNumeric(
      palette = colorRampPalette(
        c("#FF0000", "#FF5555", "#E8E8E8", "#55FF55", "#00FF00")
      )(200),
      domain = c(-bias_range, bias_range)
    )

    leaflet(plot_data) |>
      addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
    
     
      addLabelOnlyMarkers(
        data = voter_points,
        lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
        label = ~paste0(city),
        labelOptions = labelOptions(
          noHide = TRUE,
          textsize = "11px",
          offset = c(10, -10),
          style = list(
            "color" = "black",
            "font-weight" = "bold",
            "background" = "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)",
            "padding" = "3px",
            "border-radius" = "3px"
          )
        )
      ) |>
    
    
      addCircleMarkers(
        data = voter_points,
        lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
        radius = 10,
        stroke = TRUE,
        weight = 1,
        color = "black",
        fillColor = ~pal_points(bias_value),
        fillOpacity = 0.9,
        popup = ~popup,
        label = ~voter
      ) |>
    
     
      addCircleMarkers(
        data = team_coords |> filter(team_focus == input$team),
        lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
        radius = 14,
        fillColor = "black",
        stroke = TRUE,
        weight = 2,
        color = "white",
        fillOpacity = 1,
        popup = ~paste0("<strong>", team_focus, "</strong><br>Team Home Location")
      )
   
  })
}

# --- Run app ---
shinyApp(ui, server)
```
